rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for sweet candy, including candy in general and an individual piece when the context is clear.

example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 tong4

rows.note: Use this when you need to make clear that you mean one individual piece of candy.

example.english: They gave me one piece of candy to eat.
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 zo2 jat1 lap1 tong4 ngo5 sik6

rows.note: Use this for crystallized sugar or rock sugar rather than ordinary sweets.

example.english: Add a little rock candy when simmering pears.
example.jyutping: bou1 syut3 lei4 jiu3 lok6 siu2 siu2 bing1 tong4
